description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How do I ensure the idempotence of a request?](~~25693~~)

description.en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
安全组ID。

您可以调用[DescribeSecurityGroups](~~25556~~)查询可以使用的安全组。
description.en:
The security group ID of the instance.

You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](~~25556~~) operation to query available security groups in the current region.
